sources.title: International maritime voyages consultation accessible webpage

facts.source_fact: The proposed international voyage is a voyage in either direction between a UK port and a port outside the UK.
Voyages to and from Crown Dependencies and Overseas Territories are proposed to be captured.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve proposal status and territorial scope.

facts.source_fact: Participants would monitor and report 100% of voyage greenhouse-gas emissions under the proposal.
facts.expected_handling: Separate monitoring coverage from surrender percentage.

facts.source_fact: The proposed surrender obligation is 50% of international-voyage emissions.
UK in-port emissions remain subject to 100% surrender under domestic-maritime rules.
All emissions added by international expansion would be voyage emissions because in-port emissions are already within domestic scope.
Offshore ships are proposed to have 50% surrender for international-voyage emissions.
The Authority is not currently intending a 5% ice-class surrender reduction.
facts.expected_handling: Do not invent an ice-class discount.

facts.source_fact: The proposal is for inclusion from 1 January 2028.
The international proposal does not change the separate domestic-maritime commencement in July 2026.
